rules.fixed_rank_horizon: Every overall rank is scored against the same 200-player horizon. A rank of 100 therefore has the same value whether the source publishes 150 or 400 names; ranks beyond 200 add no base-quality credit.
rules.adp_is_not_quality: Keep market ADP outside the quality composite and use it to estimate availability.
rules.context_is_not_source_rank: Apply injuries, role, scheme, bye coverage, roster need, and opponent behavior after the base composite.
